changes: Real repr(C) node fields preserve pointer/mask/bit order and native-sized layouts
All three constructors and fourteen explicit node methods ported, including shallow links and native default/underflow count quirks
Protected findNext/findPrev read the actual node and update word masks, preserving empty-search return values and all-ones sentinels
Allocator ownership reuses AllocatedBox and provides explicit transfer/reclamation; no second owner registry or shadow field representation

native_matrix.layout_scope: x86_64 Linux GCC and Rust; 32-bit words produce 16-byte nodes and 64-bit words produce 24-byte nodes, both aligned to 8

ownership_extension: allocate_with/into_raw/from_raw are Rust ownership adapters, not additional original OCCT declarations; native container node allocation policy remains separate.

native_build.headers: Unmodified pinned private node and protected helpers; GCC access-control override affects the probe only.

remaining_gaps: PackedMap still uses Vec bucket chains of PackedBlock(index,bits); canonical PackedMapNode storage, raw node identity, allocation/destruction order, and iterator engine integration remain open.
Native map nodes use global C++ new/delete while buckets use Standard allocation. Injectable Rust node ownership has not established that full native allocation-policy parity.
Full class/compiler/crosswalk reconciliation and configurations beyond the sampled integral types/platform remain separate.
Node/private-method bindings do not increase the public API denominator; only the two protected helper declarations are API-visible in the current C++ inventory.
Safe Rust references express valid non-null findNext/findPrev calls; invalid native pointers are outside the tested defined domain.
